newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign investment in Shanghai's Pudong up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Shanghai's Pudong up 10 pct.

text.p: Total foreign investment in Shanghai's premier development zone of Pudong rose a year-on-year 10.8 percent to $2.76 billion in the first half of 1997, the Business News said on Wednesday.
Big manufacturing projects, accounting for 72.7 percent of the total investment, overtook real estate to become the major source of foreign investment, the newspaper said.
Sole funding, rather than joint venture investment, was now the predominant form of foreign invesment in Pudong, east of Shanghai's city centre across the Huangpu River, it said.
Of the 317 new foreign companies set up in Pudong so far this year, 73.96 percent were totally foreign funded, the newspaper said.
